name: Luddy Precollege Summer STEM Camp (Indiana University)
org: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
what_you_do: Live on the IU campus. Learn to use Python to control systems and robots. Topics include AI, cybersecurity and robot building and competition. You also cover 3D modeling, virtual worlds and smart homes.
who_can_apply: High school students entering grades 10 to 12. No experience is needed. Students are grouped by skill level.
pay_detail: Program fee $950. It covers on-campus lodging, meals and activities.
duration: Residential camp, July 2027 (exact dates not set)
deadline_text: 2027 camp: July (dates to be announced). The page says applications open in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Applications open in January 2027 through the Luddy high school programs page. Contact the summer camp team at luddycmp@iu.edu or Joshua Streiff at jostre@iu.edu.
notes: Costs money. It is a camp, not a job. The same page lists the Luddy Cybersecurity Immersion Camp, which has its own card.
